MOZ.note: INTIC's chair only says AI must be kept in mind when regulating; no draft or rule.
Nothing on digital finance consumer rules.

facts.fact: INTIC's chair lists Resolution 69/2021 of 31 December, approving the Cyber Security Policy and its implementation strategy, among the instruments in force.
facts.system: Política de Segurança Cibernética e Estratégia de sua implementação

facts.fact: INTIC's chair says the national CSIRT has been established under INTIC.
INTIC's chair says the national CSIRT's technicians watch for cyber attacks, respond to them and have alerted institutions to risks and attempted attacks on their systems.
INTIC's chair says the Cyber Security Law proposal has been submitted to the Council of Ministers and the Cybercrime Law proposal is in public consultation.
facts.system: Lei de Segurança Cibernética; Lei de Crimes Cibernéticos

facts.fact: INTIC's chair says the Personal Data Protection Law is at the stage of drafting the initial proposal.
facts.system: Lei de Protecção de Dados Pessoais

facts.fact: INTIC's chair names the Electronic Transactions Law among the instruments in force, with Decree 59/2023 of 27 October 2023 on registration and licensing of intermediary electronic service providers and digital platform operators.
INTIC's chair names the Strategic Plan for the Information Society 2019-2028 and its Operational Plan among the instruments in force.
facts.system: Plano Estratégico para a Sociedade de Informação 2019-2028

facts.fact: The Strategic Plan for the Information Society runs 2019-2028, per INTIC's chair.
facts.system: Plano Estratégico para a Sociedade de Informação 2019-2028

MOZ.note: The cybercrime bill is said to be in public consultation, but no participation by people outside government is stated.
